name: 边界场景：Start节点未配置seller_id时保存模板匹配策略
description: 验证在Start节点未配置seller_id入参的情况下，保存包含模板匹配节点的策略会失败，API返回明确的错误提示。

steps.description: 打开策略详情页（Start未配置seller_id）

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')]; for (const item of items) { const label = item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label label')?.textContent || ''; if (label.includes('匹配模式')) { const sel = item.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const dds = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dds) { const items = [...dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')]; for (const item of items) { if (item.textContent.trim() === '规则匹配') { item.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')]; for (const item of items) { const label = item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label label')?.textContent || ''; if (label.includes('数据来源')) { const sel = item.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const dds = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dds) { const items = [...dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')]; for (const item of items) { if (item.textContent.trim() === '模板库') { item.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')]; for (const item of items) { const label = item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label label')?.textContent || ''; if (label.includes('应用环节')) { const sel = item.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const dds = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dds) { const items = [...dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')]; for (const item of items) { if (item.textContent.trim() === '视觉') { item.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')]; for (const item of items) { const label = item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label label')?.textContent || ''; if (label.includes('应用场景')) { const sel = item.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const dds = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dds) { const items = [...dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')]; for (const item of items) { if (item.textContent.trim() === '主图素材') { item.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const saveBtn = [...drawer.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '保存'); if (saveBtn && !saveBtn.disabled) { saveBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); if (drawer) { const close = drawer.querySelector('.ant-drawer-close'); if (close && close.offsetHeight > 0) close.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const desc = document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder*="策略说明"]'); if (desc) { desc.value = '测试Start未配置seller_id的边界场景'; desc.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } return { ok: true }; })()
(() => { const msgs = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); return Array.from(msgs).map(m => m.textContent.trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0); })()

steps.description: 验证错误提示中包含商家ID

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录，策略详情页已打开，Start节点未配置seller_id
riskPoints: Start节点未配置seller_id时，保存API应返回明确错误
错误提示应包含'seller_id'或'商家ID'关键词
节点本身可以保存成功，但策略整体保存会失败
_testDesign.expectedBehavior: 策略保存失败，返回错误提示：该策略中包括模板匹配，但策略入参中没有商家ID
